name: Glass email open
oneLiner: a bold unread email from the brand drops into a glass inbox, a cursor clicks it, the row expands into the open email on a glass sheet lifting toward camera, and a marker sweeps over the key phrase
say: when the speaker says 'I got an email...', 'they emailed me back', or describes what lands in your inbox: the click hits as they say it, the highlight lands on the line that matters
